results.title: Monopoly Go free dice links (August 2026)
results.content:
Your net worth determines how much progress you've made in the game. With each new net worth milestone you hit, you earn in-game goodies, including hundreds of free dice rolls.

Here are in-game ways to earn free Monopoly Go dice rolls:

If Monopoly Go dice links aren't working, there's a strong possibility that they may have expired. Dice links generally last for one day before expiring, so you need to be fast if you want to claim them all. [...] There's also the possibility that you may have already redeemed the free dice. If this is the case, you should see a message appear that reads, "This reward has already been claimed." Meanwhile, expired codes appear as "Sorry, this code cannot be claimed."

If you're getting an issue where the link isn't launching the Monopoly Go app and is sending you to your platform's app store instead, try redeeming them through a different browser, even if your current one has worked previously. [...] PCGamesN is always tracking what is happening in the game, so check our schedule to see all the new Monopoly Go events ahead of time. And see below for a list of expired links, tips on getting more rolls, and if you're just starting out then we have a guide on how to how to redeem links.

To use Monopoly Go dice links, you will need to be at least level 15 to unlock albums. Once you've reached this level, simply click on the links to claim in-game rewards.
